_doc: S2.2 anchor mapping. For each node with a non-null primary in js/v2/proxy_registry.js, defines the candidate proxy series and an independent benchmark (`anchor`) for the rolling 36M Pearson correlation. When `anchor` references the same series as `candidate`, corr_36m is set to 1.0 with note 'self-anchored: candidate IS the directly observed concept (no independent public benchmark exists)'. For nodes whose `proxy_status: external` flags whitelist-source dependence (per D-001), the entry is omitted here and the harness emits a 'pending-S2.4' record instead. Permanent-not_found nodes (foreign_insurers, corporates_offshore) are also omitted.
_format: {node_id: {candidate: {source, series, metric?, freq}, anchor: {source, series, metric?, freq} | 'self', anchor_rationale: str}}

_sources.FRED: data/json/raw_observations.json (43 series) + data/json/raw_observations_v2.json (extra 9) + data/json/fed_balance_sheet.json (8 H.4.1 series)
_sources.Treasury: data/json/treasury_flows.json (tga_balance_usd_m daily; auctions_btc_by_term keyed by Bill|13-Week etc.)

bs_treasuries.anchor_rationale: TREAST is the Fed UST holdings line item itself; no independent public benchmark.

bs_agency_mbs.anchor_rationale: MBST is Fed agency MBS holdings directly; same as the node concept.

bs_primary_credit.anchor_rationale: WLCFLPCL is the Discount Window primary-credit line on H.4.1; node concept = series.

bs_cb_swaps.anchor_rationale: H41RESPPALDKNWW is central-bank USD liquidity swaps directly.

bs_reserve_balances.anchor_rationale: Cross-reference reserve balances against total Fed balance-sheet size (WALCL); demonstrates the QE/QT-driven co-movement and ΔWRESBAL ≠ ΔWALCL gap from TGA/RRP.

bs_fed_notes.anchor_rationale: CURRCIR is currency in circulation directly; structural liability.

bs_rrp.anchor_rationale: Cross-source: FRED RRPONTTLD (Overnight Reverse Repurchase Agreements: Total Operations, $B daily) vs NYFed daily ON RRP operation accepted amount; tests R001 cross-source alignment for a top-priority node. R009 fix 2026-04-26: original registry referenced RPONTSYD which in raw_observations.json contains only 610/3474 non-zero observations at magnitude ~0.001; RRPONTTLD is the correct full take-up series matching NYFed amt_accepted.

bs_rrp_omo.anchor_rationale: ON RRP open-market component is the dominant share of total operations; same anchor as bs_rrp by construction. R009 fix 2026-04-26: see bs_rrp note.

bs_foreign_repo.anchor_rationale: WLRRAL = Fed total reverse repo liability incl. foreign repo pool; closest single-series proxy for offshore USD repo reservoir.

bs_tga.anchor_rationale: Cross-source: Treasury daily TGA balance vs FRED weekly H.4.1 TGA line (WTREGEN). Tests R001 cross-source alignment between Treasury Fiscal Data and Fed H.4.1.

corporates_onshore.anchor_rationale: COMPAPER is total nonfinancial commercial paper outstanding; direct reading of corporate short-funding footprint.

fcb_swf_supra_offshore.anchor_rationale: Foreign repo pool sits inside WLRRAL; presented offshore on the diagram for flow visualization but the underlying series is the same as bs_foreign_repo.

fcb_swf_supra_onshore.anchor_rationale: Onshore-mirror node for the same foreign repo pool series.

foreign_banks.anchor_rationale: H.8 H8B1058NCBCMG is the bank-credit line for foreign-related institutions; closest single-series proxy.

us_banks.anchor_rationale: TOTBKCR is total H.8 commercial-bank credit; node concept = series.

us_fbo.anchor_rationale: Same H.8 foreign-related bank credit line; FBO and foreign_banks share the closest public proxy.

us_treasury.anchor_rationale: Treasury entity's cash position is best captured by TGA daily balance; cross-anchored against FRED H.4.1 WTREGEN for cross-source robustness (same logic as bs_tga).

dealers.anchor_rationale: S2.4 — NYFed Primary Dealer Statistics PDPOSGST-TOT (UST excl. TIPS, total dealer net position) is the canonical SLR-constrained dealer book read; no independent public benchmark.

gov_mmf.anchor_rationale: S2.4 — OFR MMF Monitor MMF-MMF_T_TOT-M (Treasury-collateralized repo holdings across MMF complex; Government MMFs dominate this bucket) cross-anchored against FRED RRPONTTLD; theory: Government MMF AUM and ON RRP take-up co-move strongly when T-bill yields drop below the RRP rate.

prime_mmf.anchor_rationale: S2.4 — OFR MMF Monitor MMF-MMF_OA_TOT-M (non-Treasury repo holdings; Prime + Tax-Exempt funds dominate this bucket) is the closest portfolio-side proxy for prime MMF scale; no cleanly separated independent fund-category-side public series exists in OFR Monitor mnemonics.

hedge_funds.anchor_rationale: S2.4 — OFR Repo Monitor REPO-DVP_OV_OO-P (DVP overnight outstanding volume; FICC-cleared sponsored repo flows through this stream) is the canonical public proxy for hedge-fund cash-futures basis-trade leverage scale; CFTC TFF UST-futures net-short positions are kept as alternates for cross-validation.
